discoveryMethod: first-party English and Chinese discovery plus bounded inspection of the official Henan Tianditu viewer and its current JavaScript configuration
sourceReview: The official Dengfeng government site identifies the local Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as responsible for unified natural-resources and real-estate registration, cadastral surveying, cadastral-results management, and the local registration information platform. The official Henan Tianditu public portal was inspected as a possible map-service route. Its current configuration exposes a public viewer and service-catalog backend, but anonymous catalog requests require authentication; no parcel feature response, safe native identity, geometry, schema, or CRS was obtained.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official Dengfeng municipal government portal was found and used for first-party source discovery.
Official institutional page identifies the Dengfeng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and its local office/contact context. It did not expose a public parcel viewer or feature endpoint.

Official departmental page states that the bureau implements unified natural-resources and real-estate registration, cadastral surveying, dispute handling, results application, and management of the real-estate registration information platform. This is local registry-custodian evidence, not parcel geometry evidence.
Official municipal opinion documents Dengfeng land and real-estate registration procedures, including cadastral investigation where needed. No anonymous map/API route or polygon was exposed.

Official Henan geographic-information public-service portal loaded. The homepage exposed the current viewer JavaScript entrypoint and a public map/service catalog product, but no parcel layer was directly available from the HTML.

Current viewer JavaScript was inspected to follow its service-home route. It referenced the official service platform but did not provide a safe parcel feature endpoint or a parcel schema/CRS response.

The official viewer configuration was inspected. It exposed service-catalog and map-manager route patterns, but the configuration includes platform authentication settings; no credentials or private tokens were used, and no authenticated request was attempted.
Anonymous service-catalog request returned {code:401,msg:未认证}. No login, credential use, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or private-token request was attempted.
Anonymous service-department request returned {code:401,msg:未认证}; no parcel data was returned.
Anonymous data-resource request returned {code:401,msg:未认证}; no parcel data, schema, or CRS was returned.
